title: No One Has Ever Seen This Fish Be Born or Breed
subject: European eel

scenes.text: Every eel in Europe is born in a place no one has ever seen.
The European eel. Adults slip out to sea and swim 3,000 to 6,000 miles.
They head for the Sargasso Sea near Bermuda. No scientist has ever watched them spawn there.
Researchers tagged 707 eels. Most were eaten, but 87 survivors swam about 3,000 miles toward the Azores.
For two thousand years nobody could find eel eggs. Aristotle decided eels grew from earthworms.
So every European eel starts life in a place nobody has seen.

description:
Every European eel starts life in a place no human has seen.
Adults swim thousands of miles to the Sargasso Sea, and no one has ever watched them spawn.
How do you think they find the way?
first_comment: Aristotle thought eels grew from mud. What's the strangest animal theory you've heard?
